name: node-solr-lambda
description: A typed Apache Solr client for Node.js

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && node scripts/copy-declarations.mjs && node --input-type=module -e "import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs'; writeFileSync('dist/esm/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'module'})); writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
scripts.release:check: npm run test:api-inventory && npm run docs:check && npm run test:consumer:no-zod && npm run test:bench && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test:types && npm test && npm run build && npm run release:check
scripts.docs:check: node scripts/check-docs.mjs && npm run site:check && npm run test:site-data
scripts.build:site: npm run site:generate && npm run site:check -- --data build/site-data.json && npm run test:site-data && npm run test:site-generator && npm run site:build && npm run test:site-assets
